programme.title: Viaje a Italia
programme.desc: Steve Coogan y Rob Brydon reciben el encargo de un nuevo viaje gastronómico, esta vez por Italia. Estos dos improbables amigos conducen por todo el país mientras vuelven a discutir sobre la vida, el amor y el cine.

programme.title: Moby Dick
programme.desc: El Pequod es un barco ballenero cuyo objetivo principal es cazar a la mítica ballena blanca. Al mando de la nave está el tiránico capitán Ahab, que vive obsesionado con la idea de capturar al animal que consiguió escapar después de arrancarle una pierna.

programme.title: La sombra del cazador
programme.desc: Un joven periodista, un cámara y un desacreditado corresponsal de guerra emprenden una misión no autorizada para encontrar al delincuente de guerra más buscado de Bosnia.

programme.title: Hitler: El ascenso del mal - Parte 1
programme.desc: Una perspectiva única, que perfila la vida de Adolf Hitler como un niño y su ascenso a través de las filas del Partido Nacional Alemán de los Trabajadores antes de la Segunda Guerra Mundial.

programme.title: Hitler: El ascenso del mal - Parte 2
programme.desc: Una perspectiva única, que perfila la vida de Adolf Hitler como un niño y su ascenso a través de las filas del Partido Nacional Alemán de los Trabajadores antes de la Segunda Guerra Mundial.

programme.title: El Jurado
programme.desc: En este thriller lleno de suspense, un "asesor" del jurado despiadado y de alto precio no se detendrá ante nada para asegurar un veredicto en un juicio explosivo.

programme.title: Conan el bárbaro
programme.desc: Las hazañas de Conan en la Era Hiboria cobran ahora vida como no se habían visto jamás en una colosal película de acción y aventuras.

programme.title: MS1: Máxima seguridad
programme.desc: MS1 es una prisión en el espacio donde los 500 criminales más peligrosos se encuentran retenidos. El agente Snow deberá resolver una situación de rehénes en la prisión. Protagonizan Guy Pearce (Memento) y Maggie Grace (Perdidos).

programme.title: Teniente Corrupto
programme.desc: El teniente Terence McDonough, adicto a las drogas por sus dolores crónicos de espalda, investiga el asesinato de cinco inmigrantes senegaleses en Nueva Orleans.

programme.title: Brotherhood
programme.desc: El hermano de un hombre que ha fingido su muerte y robado un monton de dinero de una banda, trata de descubrir la verdad y encontrar a su asesino.

programme.title: El duodécimo hombre
programme.desc: En 1943, en la Noruega ocupada por Alemania, un grupo de saboteadores es traicionado y apresado por las tropas nazis. De los 12 integrantes del comando, sólo uno consigue sobrevivir.

programme.title: Monter's Battlefield
programme.desc: Ye Qin, la prometida del rey soldado Qin Yang, murió trágicamente frente a una bestia gigante desconocida. Gu Ping lo invitó a participar en la investigación de Ye Qin durante su vida.

programme.title: Doble identidad
programme.desc: Un médico estadounidense es testigo de un asalto y ayuda a la joven víctima, una misteriosa mujer, a huir. Desde ese momento, su vida está en peligro y deberá ingeniárselas para sobrevivir en un país en el que no puede acudir a nadie en busca de ayuda.

programme.title: Los tigres del tren
programme.desc: Un ferroviario en la China de 1941 lucha contra los japoneses para lograr comida para los pobres. Pronto se embarcarán en una misión suicida para volar un puente.

programme.title: Traición
programme.desc: Julio reúne a todos los miembros de su familia y les anuncia que padece una enfermedad mortal y que planea hacer algunos cambios en su empresa.

programme.title: Bienvenido A Hamburgo
programme.desc: En su primera misión en Investigación Criminal, Nick Tschiller descubre un piso usado para explotar a menores. Un violento tiroteo acaba con la muerte de tres miembros del Clan Astan, desatando un peligroso conflicto.

programme.title: Indomable
programme.desc: Una agente sumamente preparada es traicionada y dada por muerta por alguien de su propia agencia. Cuando las cosas se descontrolan, encuentra la manera de cambiar las tornas frente a su despiadado adversario.

programme.title: Los Mercenarios
programme.desc: Barney Ross (Stallone) es un veterano de guerra que ha reunido a un grupo de mercenarios de élite para operaciones puntuales de rescate. No dudan en matar para conseguir sus objetivos, si bien tienen un lema muy claro: "sólo a quienes lo merezcan".

programme.title: Templario II: Batalla por la sangre
programme.desc: Reunidos por el joven Hubert, un reducido grupo de espadas a sueldo se reúne para buscar venganza por la muerte del hijo de uno de los mercenarios.

programme.title: Lotoman 003
programme.desc: Miguel y Modesto Marchena están de vuelta en la pobreza. Un enfrentamiento con un par de ciclistas ladrones los convierte en héroes locales y los pone en contacto con una agencia secreta que los recluta para una tarea.

programme.title: Entrega especial
programme.desc: Una mujer que se dedica a la mensajería especial recibe el más insólito encargo: deberá recoger a una adolescente rebelde en el domicilio paterno situado en China y entregarla a su madre en Occidente.

programme.title: Con la magia en los zapatos
programme.desc: Un zapatero, aburrido de su vida cotidiana, tropieza con una reliquia mágica que le permite convertirse en otras personas y ver el mundo de otra manera.

programme.title: Los líos de Gray
programme.desc: Gray y Sam (Heather Graham y Tom Cavanagh) son hermanos, pero tan compatibles e inseparables que la gente cree que son pareja.

programme.title: El permiso
programme.desc: Cuando a una reclusa se le concede un fin de semana fuera de prisión para ver a su madre moribunda, un oficial de corrección novato lucha por mantenerla bajo control.

programme.title: Crónicas diplomáticas
programme.desc: El Ministerio de Asuntos Exteriores contrata al joven Arthur Vlaminck como encargado del “lenguaje”. En otras palabras, redactará los discursos del ministro.

programme.title: La boda de Rosa
programme.desc: A punto de cumplir 45 años, Rosa se da cuenta de que siempre ha vivido su vida para servir a los demás, por lo que decide dejarlo todo atrás, tomar las riendas de su vida y cumplir su sueño de emprender su propio negocio.

programme.title: Life of Brian
programme.desc: Brian nace en un pesebre de Belén el mismo día que Jesucristo. Un cúmulo de desgraciados y tronchantes equívocos le harán llevar una vida paralela a la del verdadero Hijo de Dios.

programme.title: American Girls
programme.desc: Sam, un estudiante de arte con problemas, conoce a Hope en su mal día.

programme.title: Juerga de mamis
programme.desc: Cuatro madres salen a cenar juntas y terminan viviendo una noche inesperada llena de aventuras.

programme.title: Conversaciones con otras mujeres
programme.desc: Un hombre y una mujer próximos a los cuarenta se conocen en una boda en un hotel neoyorkino. Entablarán una conversación llena de ingenio y dobles sentidos en la que cada uno va cercando al otro con la precisión de un felino.

programme.title: Sultanes del Sur
programme.desc: Cuatro profesionales atracan un banco en México. Consiguen un botín de 11 millones de dólares, y se van a Buenos Aires para cambiar los dólares por pesos.

programme.title: Capricornio Uno
programme.desc: El primer viaje a Marte presenciado mundialmente es en realidad un simulacro. Los tres astronautas designados para la misión se ven obligados a participar en la farsa, hasta que un técnico de la NASA decide investigar.

programme.title: Acoso perfecto
programme.desc: Cuando una mujer (Danielle Savre) que sufre un trastorno histriónico de la personalidad se obsesiona con su nuevo vecino, se inventa un acosador imaginario.

programme.title: Cut Bank
programme.desc: Dwayne, un joven que fue atleta estrella y que ahora trabaja como mecánico, sueña con irse de la población de Cut Bank - la ciudad más fría de los EE.UU. - y mudarse a la gran ciudad, llevándose consigo a su novia Cassandra, que sueña con ser modelo.

programme.title: The Guilty Ones
programme.desc: La hija de BAI fue secuestrada y murió accidentalmente hace diez años, el oficial Chen le prometió atrapar al criminal pero se retiró sin ningún resultado.

programme.title: Mentira de familias
programme.desc: Después de que sus padres murieran en lo que parece un accidente de coche, Emily y sus hermanos menores se mudan a un pequeño pueblo de Luisiana. Pronto comienzan a suceder cosas extrañas, dando a los hermanos la sensación de que están siendo observados.

programme.title: Obsession
programme.desc: Sonia Paston acepta una gran promoción laboral que significa dejar su vida en Nueva York para mudarse a un pequeño pueblo cerca de Boston. Aún si ella esta lista para irse, alguien no esta dispuesto a vivir sin ella.

programme.title: Resistencia
programme.desc: Bielorrusia, 1941. Tres hermanos judíos logran escapar de una muerte segura y se refugian en los bosques, que conocen desde su infancia. Protagonizada por Daniel Craig (Casino Royale) y dirigida por Edward Zwick (Diamante de sangre).

programme.title: Mátalos suavemente
programme.desc: Un sicario es contratado para investigar un robo relacionado con la mafia.

programme.title: Puntos extra por asesinato
programme.desc: Maisy se traslada a la universidad de su difunta hermana para investigar las circunstancias de su muerte.

programme.title: Mia Madre
programme.desc: Margherita, una directora de cine está en pleno rodaje de una película protagonizada por un famoso actor estadounidense. A las preguntas que se plantea en calidad de artista comprometida se suman preocupaciones de orden privado...

programme.title: Nora
programme.desc: Dublín, 1904, James Joyce conversa con Nora Barnacle, una camarera de hotel recién llegada de Galway. Ella lo encanta con su actitud franca y desinhibida y, en poco tiempo, la convence de que lo acompañe a Trieste.

programme.title: Two Lovers
programme.desc: Leonard (Joaquin Phoenix) empieza a salir con Sandra (Vinessa Shaw), una joven encantadora con la que el matrimonio parece cercano. Pero aparece en su vida una nueva vecina, Michelle (Gwyneth Paltrow), lo que no hace sino empezar a complicar su vida.

programme.title: Presunta inocencia
programme.desc: En esta secuela de Presunto inocente de Scott Turrow, el juez Rusty Sabich (Bill Pullman) se encuentra de nuevo en el centro de la investigación de un asesinato cuando se le acusa de haber matado a su esposa.

programme.title: Primavera en Normandía
programme.desc: Un panadero observa cómo su vecina repite sin saberlo la historia de Madame Bovary.

programme.title: Invencible
programme.desc: Zishe trabaja actuando como forzudo en Berlín. Mientras Hitler se va consolidando en el poder y en Berlín estalla el antisemitismo, Zishe llega a la conclusión de que ha sido elegido por Dios para advertir a su pueblo del peligro que avecina.

programme.title: Valkiria
programme.desc: En plena Segunda Guerra Mundial, un grupo de altos mandos alemanes desarrollan un plan para asesinar a Adolf Hitler, y aprovechar el poder de los mandos militares para acabar con la guerra.

programme.title: El Lobo
programme.desc: En este taquillazo del cine español Mikel Lejarza (Eduardo Noriega), alias "Lobo", fue un agente de los servicios secretos españoles que consiguió infiltrarse en ETA

programme.title: El secreto del lago
programme.desc: Un adolescente descubre un oscuro secreto que desata una peligrosa cadena de acontecimientos.

programme.title: La fuente de los deseos
programme.desc: La propietaria de una tienda de mascotas de San Francisco se reencuentra con su primer amor y debe resistirse a enamorarse de él por segunda vez.

programme.title: New York, I Love You
programme.desc: Siguiendo los pasos del éxito de "Paris, je t'aime" doce directores y varios actores de primera línea toman la ciudad de Nueva York como set y narran diferentes historias de amor.

programme.title: Recuerdos del corazón
programme.desc: With her husband jailed for Wall Street fraud, Faith leaves her life of luxury behind to return to rural North Carolina and the father and sister she'd left behind.

programme.title: Algo Prestado
programme.desc: Las amistades se ponen a prueba y los secretos salen a la luz cuando Rachel, soltera recalcitrante, se enamora de Dex, el prometido de su mejor amiga Darcy.

programme.title: La decisión de Sophie
programme.desc: Ganadora del Oscar a Mejor Actriz (Meryl Streep) y dirigida por Alan Pakula (El informe Pelícano). Stingo, un joven con ambiciones literarias se traslada a Brooklyn, donde conoce a una inmigrante polaca llamada Sophie, una superviviente de Auschwitz...

programme.title: Mensaje De Amor En Una Botella
programme.desc: Desafortunadamente en el amor, Abbey comparte las frustraciones de sus citas con su tía, quien sugiere que escriba una carta de amor explicando los deseos de su verdadero corazón.

programme.title: La segunda oportunidad
programme.desc: Una madre divorciada intenta hacer las paces con su disfuncional familia encontrando una segunda oportunidad en el amor.

programme.title: La señorita Julia
programme.desc: Una noche de verano en una mansión en el campo irlandés en 1880. La película explora la lucha de poder entre una joven aristócrata y el criado de su padre.

programme.title: El permiso
programme.desc: Cuando a una reclusa se le concede un fin de semana fuera de prisión para ver a su madre moribunda, un oficial de corrección novato lucha por mantenerla bajo control.

programme.title: Papita, Maní, Tostón
programme.desc: Andrés, un fanático del club de béisbol Leones, obtiene por error las entradas para el área VIP de los Navegantes, su equipo rival. Cuando conoce a Julissa y se enamora, van a complacer a sus familias, fingiendo ser fanáticos de los otros equipos.

programme.title: San Andreas mega seísmo
programme.desc: Los científicos descubren algo horrible: el "Gran Terremoto" será en dos días y hundirá California en el océano. Su única esperanza es romper un volcán que desplazará la energía del terremoto y construirá una nueva corteza en la superficie.

programme.title: Tentáculos de las Bermudas
programme.desc: Cuando el Air Force One cae sobre el Triángulo de las Bermudas, la Marina envía su mejor equipo de rescate. Pero mientras salvan el presidente, el equipo despierta a una criatura que amenaza a toda la costa este.

programme.title: 10.000 días
programme.desc: Hace 10.000 días, un cometa impactó con la Tierra en pleno océano Pacífico con la fuerza de incontables bombas nucleares, sumiendo al planeta en nieve y hielo.

programme.title: Fahrenheit 451
programme.desc: En un futuro opresivo Guy Montag, un disciplinado bombero encargado de quemar los libros prohibidos por el gobierno, conoce a una revolucionaria maestra que se atreve a leer.

programme.title: Código fuente
programme.desc: Jake Gyllenhaal protagoniza este thriller de acción sobre un hombre que despierta en el cuerpo de otro hombre para descubrir que solo él tiene la capacidad de detener un ataque terrorista en un tren de cercanías.

programme.title: Freaked. La disparatada parada de los monstruos
programme.desc: Ricky, contratado por una empresa para patrocinar un componente químico, descubre que la molécula es responsable de monstruosas deformidades.

programme.title: Infinitum
programme.desc: Jane debe cambiar su realidad en un universo paralelo por su cuenta.

programme.title: Amor de ida y vuelta
programme.desc: Dos actores de fenómenos televisivos (Juego de Tronos y Sex Education) protagonizan este fantástico romance. Un joven (Asa Butterfield) inventa una máquina del tiempo para recuperar a su exnovia (Sophie Turner).

programme.title: Pandorum
programme.desc: Dos astronautas despiertan en una nave abandonada llena de peligros desconocidos.

programme.title: Brazil
programme.desc: En un mundo futurista, un burócrata intenta corregir un error administrativo y rápidamente se convierte en un enemigo público.

programme.title: Cyborg 2
programme.desc: Una enorme cantidad de pasillos subterráneos nos llevan hasta unos laboratorios donde se crean unas extrañas criaturas: sintetizadores humanos.

programme.title: El Gatopardo
programme.desc: El príncipe de Salina trata de preservar su familia y su clase en medio de los trastornos sociales de la Sicilia de 1860.

programme.title: Ensayo de orquesta
programme.desc: En una capilla medieval romana, una orquesta se prepara para ensayar. Los acompaña un equipo de Televisión. El director es un alemán que insulta a los músicos y los trata mal. Después de un descanso, éstos se rebelan contra él...

programme.title: Ensayo de orquesta
programme.desc: En una capilla medieval romana, una orquesta se prepara para ensayar. Los acompaña un equipo de Televisión. El director es un alemán que insulta a los músicos y los trata mal. Después de un descanso, éstos se rebelan contra él...

programme.title: Melancolía
programme.desc: Con motivo de su matrimonio, Justine y Michael dan una suntuosa recepción en la casa de la hermana de Justine y de su cuñado. Mientras tanto, el planeta Melancholia se dirige hacia la Tierra.

programme.title: De tal padre, tal hijo
programme.desc: ¿Con quién se quedaría, con su hijo natural, o con el hijo que ha creído suyo durante seis años? Una familia sufrirá lo indecible después de recibir una llamada del hospital donde nació su hijo.

programme.title: Cuatro vidas
programme.desc: La película se Basa en un proverbio chino según el cual la existencia humana se divide en cuatro emociones: felicidad, placer, pena y amor. Estas emociones acaban cruzándose a través de cuatro personajes.

programme.title: Cut Bank
programme.desc: Dwayne, un joven que fue atleta estrella y que ahora trabaja como mecánico, sueña con irse de la población de Cut Bank - la ciudad más fría de los EE.UU. - y mudarse a la gran ciudad, llevándose consigo a su novia Cassandra, que sueña con ser modelo.

programme.title: El tercer hombre
programme.desc: Ganadora del Oscar a Mejor Fotografía B/N. En 1947, un escritor llega a Viena, ocupada por tropas aliadas, donde existe un mercado negro de víveres, para aceptar un empleo de un amigo. Pero éste ha muerto en extrañas circunstancias.

programme.title: La casa de Jack
programme.desc: EE.UU. años setenta. Seguimos al inteligentísimo Jack durante cinco incidentes y descubrimos los asesinatos que le definen como asesino en serie. Vivimos la historia desde la perspectiva de Jack. Considera cada asesinato como una obra de arte...

programme.title: Sleuth
programme.desc: Andrew Wyke (Laurence Olivier) es un prestigioso escritor de novelas de intriga. Una tarde, invita a su casa a Milo Tindle (Michael Caine), amante de su mujer

programme.desc: Hace 10.000 días, un cometa impactó con la Tierra en pleno océano Pacífico con la fuerza de incontables bombas nucleares, sumiendo al planeta en nieve y hielo.

programme.title: Evidencias del Crimen: Dos Acusados por una Muerte
programme.desc: El domingo 29 de abril de 2007, el cuerpo de Jennifer Charron, de 21 años, fue encontrado quemado en un bosque cerca de Royan.

programme.title: Evidencias del Crimen: La Fiesta Estudiantil Mortal
programme.desc: El 24 de diciembre de 2008, el cuerpo de Stéphane Kameugne fue sacado de un canal en Châlons-en-Champagne.

programme.title: Contra Reloj
programme.desc: El ambiente sereno de Marcq-en-Barroeil se vio roto por la abrupta desaparición de Natacha Mougel durante su carrera de rutina.

programme.title: Contra Reloj
programme.desc: París se vio invadida por el miedo tras el violento ataque de AbdelHakim Dekhar.

programme.title: Casos Sin Resolver
programme.desc: La noche del 10 de enero de 2002, Elodie Kulik, una joven de 24 años, sale de la sucursal bancaria que dirige en Péronne, en el departamento francés de Somme.

programme.title: Casos Sin Resolver
programme.desc: 9 de agosto de 2004. Los cadáveres de Robert Drouvin y su compañera Marianne Kubala son hallados en el parque de su propiedad en Vernou-sur-Brenne, en Indre y Loira.

programme.title: Las Primeras 72 Horas Tras El Crimen: Tender una Trampa
programme.desc: La investigación del asesinato de un turbio hombre de negocios de Montreal lleva a los detectives al escabroso submundo de traficantes de drogas.

programme.title: Las Primeras 72 Horas Tras El Crimen: Avión Secuestrado
programme.desc: En 1971, antes de la era de la seguridad aeroportuaria, un Pantera Negra secuestra un avión con destino a La Habana, Cuba.

programme.title: Misterios sin resolver: Episodio 9
programme.desc: Presentado por Robert Stack, esta serie usa recreaciones y entrevistas para volver a narrar las circunstancias de los misterios que permanecen sin resolver. Cubriendo crímenes, historias de un amor perdido, historias inexplicadas y eventos paranormales.

programme.title: Misterios sin resolver: Episodio 10
programme.desc: Este episodio incluye: Casería de Brujas & Actualización, Actualización: Amigos Hasta el Final, Tiempo Faltante Partes 1 & 2 y Amnesia de Infarto & Actualización.

programme.title: Cruise Ship Killers
programme.desc: Una mujer de 40 años decide embarcarse en un crucero espontáneo sin informar a su familia. Cuando desaparece en la segunda noche del crucero, su familia buscará respuestas y cambiará la forma en que se reportan las desapariciones en el mar.

programme.title: Cruise Ship Killers
programme.desc: Una subchef a bordo de un crucero abandona su turno inesperadamente y nunca más se la vuelve a ver. ¿La presión de la cocina la llevó al suicidio o hubo juego sucio? ¿Alguien a bordo la vio antes de desaparecer? ¿Qué pistas existen sobre su paradero?

programme.title: La Paca, Matriarca de la Droga
programme.desc: Durante décadas, el imperio de la Paca creció exponencialmente junto a su fortuna.

programme.title: La Paca, Matriarca de la Droga
programme.desc: Dos operaciones policiales intentaron acabar con el imperio de La Paca.

programme.title: Jeffrey Dahmer: Asesino Canibal
programme.desc: De ser un niño feliz a convertirse en un asesino, así es la historia de Jeffrey Dahmer. Su infancia, sus combativos padres, su obsesión por los animales muertos, su extraño comportamiento en el instituto y sus primeros deseos sexuales.

programme.title: Jeffrey Dahmer: Asesino Canibal
programme.desc: Increíblemente, Dahmer oculta su segundo asesinato metiendo un cadáver en una maleta con la que cruza el vestíbulo de un hotel hasta un taxi. Pese a ser un asesino a sangre fría, su carisma le permite salirse con la suya.

programme.title: Jeffrey Dahmer: Asesino Canibal
programme.desc: Dahmer disfruta de su primera comida caníbal. Descubre que lo que más le gusta es el bíceps. Lo cocina en una sartén y lo sazona con sal, pimienta y salsa. Mientras se suceden los asesinatos, una llamada de su madre agrava el frenesí mortal.

programme.title: Jeffrey Dahmer: Asesino Canibal
programme.desc: Otra víctima escapa, esta vez desnuda, drogada y sangrando. Los testigos llaman a emergencias. Pero Dahmer convence a la policía de que es solo una "discusión de novios". Se está volviendo descuidado y los cuerpos se amontonan.

programme.title: La Batalla OVNI de Los Ángeles
programme.desc: 1942 LA: Un misterioso OVNI causa apagón y fuego de artillería. Permanece sin explicación.

programme.title: Extraterrestres en la URSS
programme.desc: Misterios alienígenas sin resolver de la Unión Soviética: incidente del Paso Dyatlov, milagro de Petrozavodsk, caso Voronezh. Asombro y miedo, pero duda de la participación alienígena.

programme.title: Sociedades secretas y el nuevo orden mundial
programme.desc: En casi todas las culturas existen leyendas que narran sobre una Raza Antigua que pobló la Tierra hace millones de años. Esta raza tiene orígenes extraterrestres y era inmensamente inteligente y científicamente avanzada.

programme.title: Archivos Gubernamentales de OVNIs Desclasificados
programme.desc: Los gobiernos guardan secretos. ¿Pero qué ocurre cuando estos secretos ya no pueden ser encubiertos más?

programme.title: Proyecto Serpo
programme.desc: 2005: Ex agente revela un informe de 3.000 páginas sobre una misión secreta de intercambio ET al planeta Serpo

programme.title: Fronteras inexploradas: Astronautas
programme.desc: Cien kilómetros sobre la superficie de la Tierra se encuentra una frontera invisible : el borde del espacio.

programme.title: Fronteras inexploradas: Llegar arriba
programme.desc: Lanzar cargamentos al espacio es una tarea muy difícil. Misiles diseñados para ojivas atómicas ahora envían satélites al sistema solar. Es una de las pocas hazañas de la humanidad que no ocurre en la naturaleza.

programme.title: Fronteras inexploradas: La órbita
programme.desc: La Estación Espacial Internacional es, sin duda, la joya de la corona de la órbita terrestre baja; puesto de observación, laboratorio de investigación y aula.

programme.title: Fronteras inexploradas: De costa a costa
programme.desc: Nuestra naturaleza marinera se ha traducido bien en la era espacial, buscando navegar hacia lo desconocido en busca de riquezas de un tipo u otro.

programme.title: OVNIs Nazis
programme.desc: Se rumorea que la Alemania Nazi desarrolló naves espaciales avanzadas y que científicos continuaron en bunkers en la Antártida y Sudamérica. Sin evidencia, la teoría mezcla esoterismo y restauración nazi paranormal.

programme.title: La Abducción de las Colinas: El Incidente Zeta Reticuli
programme.desc: Se explora el secuestro de Barney y Betty Hill y el incidente de Zeta reticuli.

programme.title: Cazadores De Ovnis: Los Ufólogos Italianos
programme.desc: Investigadores italianos exploran avistamientos masivos de ovnis, clipeología y testimonios reales, profundizando en la historia y los métodos de investigación de la ufología.

programme.title: Extraterrestres Subterráneos, Baba Vanga y Biología Cuántica
programme.desc: Baba Vanga, una mística búlgara ciega, hizo predicciones desde los 12 años hasta su muerte en 1996. Sus profecías se extendieron hasta el año 5079.

programme.title: Encuentros Extraterrestres: Los Grises
programme.desc: ¿Quiénes son los alienígenas grises y cuál es su interés en nuestro mundo? En este documental exploramos los posibles motivos detrás de tres de los encuentros más prolíficos en nuestra historia.

programme.title: Extraterrestres contra la Guerra Nuclear: Edgar Mitchell
programme.desc: 12 caminantes lunares afirman que los extraterrestres visitaron la Tierra, el gobierno lo encubrió. Los extraterrestres detuvieron la guerra nuclear. ¿Loco o vale la pena escuchar más?

programme.title: Ingenieros Extraterrestres
programme.desc: Nuestra evolución puede estar influenciada por nuestros antepasados y sus dioses. No estamos solos en el universo.

programme.title: Z Nation
programme.desc: En el puesto Altura, 10K busca a Red, Murphy encuentra a Sun Mei y Doc se topa con Ciudadano Z.

programme.title: Z Nation
programme.desc: Se desata el pánico cuando una explosión retrasa la votación. Los rumores culpan a un conversador.

programme.title: Z Nation
programme.desc: 10K y Rojo asisten a una ceremonia en Altura. Warren, Doc, Ciudadano Z y George llegan a Pacífica.

programme.title: Z Nation
programme.desc: Una nueva ola de atentados golpea Pacifica. George contempla su visión para unir a humanos y conversadores.

programme.title: Un cubo de sangre
programme.desc: Un ayudante de camarero tonto es aclamado como artista por un gato muerto cubierto de yeso que se confunde con una hábil estatuilla. El deseo de más elogios pronto conduce a una serie de obras cada vez más mortales.

programme.title: Ausentes
programme.desc: Julia y Samuel se mudan con los niños a una urbanización en las afueras de la ciudad. Parece un lugar ideal, pero Julia pronto descubrirá que tan idílico paraje esconde algo extraño. Se da cuenta de que la urbanización está completamente desierta.

programme.title: La Senda
programme.desc: En un intento por salvar su matrimonio, Raúl decide pasar las Navidades con su familia en una cabaña aislada en medio de la nieve. Durante la Nochebuena todo parece marchar bien, pero, de repente, la situación da un giro totalmente inesperado.

programme.title: Dictado
programme.desc: Tras quedarse huérfana, Julia es acogida por Daniel y Laura. Daniel percibe en la conducta de la niña un carácter amenazador que le trae a la memoria un pasado terrorífico que había decidido enterrar para siempre.

programme.title: Dark Angel
programme.desc: La relación de Alex y Evan toma un giro diferente a medida que ambos comienzan de nuevo. Kelly da un salto hacia lo desconocido y Christian propone a Chloe, el nuevo jefe de Miranda, con una canción.

programme.title: Dark Angel
programme.desc: Kelly tiene la mejor noche de su vida, mientras que Alex y Rex tienen una de las más difíciles. Evan se sumerge en el mundo publicitario.

programme.title: The Dead Girl ES
programme.desc: El asesinato de una joven reúne las historias de cinco mujeres: Lonely Arden descubre el cuerpo, Leah cree que la víctima puede ser su hermana desaparecida. Melora cree que es su hija, mientras que Ruth hace un descubrimiento aterrador.

programme.title: Oscuras intenciones
programme.desc: Molly is struggling with being a new mom, but after meeting Beth, things temporarily improve only to turn as Beth's dark intentions are brought to light.

programme.title: Secuestrada en la isla
programme.desc: Una madre soltera arriesga su vida para salvar a su hija, fascinada por las estrellas, de las garras de una red de tráfico sexual dirigida por un agente de talentos en una isla aislada.

programme.title: Ojos que te acechan
programme.desc: "El Ojo" es un agente especial del Servicio Británico, cuya misión es seguir a Joanna Eris, una mujer sospechosa de chantajear a un miembro del gobierno

programme.title: The Crucifixion
programme.desc: Una periodista investiga la muerte de una monja durante un exorcismo.

programme.title: A pleno sol
programme.desc: Tom Ripley es un prodigioso impostor, gorrón, falsificador y delincuente de la improvisación en general

programme.title: Andrómeda
programme.desc: Un monstruo espacial mitológico intenta comerse la Andrómeda.

programme.title: Andrómeda
programme.desc: Dylan intenta liberar una flota de naves capturadas, pero la flota no está segura de que quiera ser liberada. Sus AIs temen que los nuevos capitanes los esclavicen.
programme.sub-title: El Caballero, la Muerte y el Diablo

programme.title: Andrómeda
programme.desc: Los genitas atacan a la esposa y colonia de Tyr.

programme.title: Andrómeda
programme.desc: Con cincuenta partidos a bordo, Dylan es el anfitrión de la firma de la carta de la Nueva Mancomunidad, pero pronto descubre que hay intrusos empeñados en detener la firma.
programme.sub-title: Túnel al Final de la Luz

programme.title: Andrómeda
programme.desc: Después de quedar varado cerca de un agujero negro, el capitán Dylan Hunt es descubierto por un barco de salvamento mercenario y descubre que ha estado congelado en el tiempo durante 300 años.

programme.title: Andrómeda
programme.desc: Dylan protege a la Andrómeda de los mercenarios mientras Beka comienza a preguntarse si están luchando por el lado equivocado.

programme.title: Andrómeda: Aflojando el Fatídico Relámpago
programme.desc: Dylan encuentra una estación espacial llena de niños que creen que está allí para traer la paz matando a sus enemigos.

programme.title: Andrómeda: D Menos Cero
programme.desc: La tripulación de Andrómeda todavía está aprendiendo a trabajar juntos mientras son atacados por los Restauradores.

programme.title: Andrómeda: Doble Hélice
programme.desc: La Andrómeda se involucra en una disputa entre un planeta Than y una colonia Nietzschean.

programme.title: Andrómeda: Ángel Oscuro, Demonio Brillante
programme.desc: Una corriente de deslizamiento envía a la Andrómeda de vuelta en el tiempo a justo antes de que cayera la Mancomunidad. La tripulación debe intervenir para preservar la historia.

programme.title: Andrómeda: Los Lazos que Atan
programme.desc: Responder a una llamada de socorro lleva a la tripulación a recoger al hermano de Beka, ahora un Wayist, y a su amigo.

programme.title: Andrómeda: Los Bancos del Leteo
programme.desc: Un agujero negro permite a Dylan comunicarse con su ex prometida, 300 años en el pasado.

programme.title: Andrómeda: Una Rosa en las Cenizas
programme.desc: Dylan es encarcelado en un planeta carcelario y debe organizar una fuga mientras su tripulación intenta organizar su propio rescate.

programme.title: Andrómeda: Todo el Océano del Gran Neptuno
programme.desc: Los Castalians abordan el Andrómeda para finalizar la carta de la Nueva Mancomunidad. Cuando el líder es descubierto muerto, Tyr es el principal sospechoso.
programme.sub-title: Todo el Océano del Gran Neptuno

programme.title: Andrómeda: Las Perlas Que Fueron Sus Ojos
programme.desc: Beka se entera de que el ex socio de negocios de su padre se ocupa de una droga altamente adictiva llamada Flash.
programme.sub-title: Las Perlas Que Fueron Sus Ojos

programme.title: Andrómeda: Las Matemáticas de las Lágrimas
programme.desc: La Andrómeda descubre su nave hermana, la Pax Magellanic. La tripulación a bordo del Pax tiene 300 años, pero no ha envejecido ni un día.

programme.title: Andrómeda: Música de un Tambor Distante
programme.desc: Tyr se estrella contra el Eureka Maru en un planeta Nietzschean y desarrolla amnesia. Debe recordar lo que está haciendo antes de que los Nietzscheans lo descubran a él y a su caja de bienes robados.

programme.title: Andrómeda: Harper 2.0
programme.desc: Harper recibe el don del conocimiento de un Perseid moribundo, sólo para descubrir que el Perseid estaba siendo buscado por un cazarrecompensas que ahora ha vuelto su atención a Harper.

programme.title: Andrómeda: Perspectiva Forzada
programme.desc: Dylan fue arrestado por asesinar a un dictador hace 300 años.

programme.title: Andrómeda: La Suma de Sus Partes
programme.desc: Andrómeda está embarcada por un dron del Consenso de Partes, una sociedad mecánica mítica. Mientras que amistoso al principio, el dron intenta forzar a la nave a unirse al Consenso.

programme.title: Andrómeda: Miedo y Desprecio en la Vía Láctea
programme.desc: Gerentex está de vuelta, y exige que Trance y Harper lo ayuden con su nuevo plan: encontrar a Tarn-Vedra.
programme.sub-title: Miedo y Desprecio en la Vía Láctea

programme.title: Woody Herman, Paul Fontaine, Billy Hunt & Bill Chase
programme.sub-title: Woody Herman's Swinging Herd live in England 1964
programme.desc: Woody Herman: Live in '64 features a blistering one-hour concert from 1964 showcasing one of the very hottest line-ups of the "Swinging Herd," including trumpeter Bill Chase, trombonist Phil Wilson, and the amazing saxophonist Sal Nistico on the front line, as well as drummer Jake Hanna, bassist Chuck Andrus, and pianist-arranger Nat Pierce in the rhythm section. The band roars throughout the entire show which includes standards such as "Lonesome Old Town", "After You've Gone", and new originals including Charles Mingus's "Better Git It In Your Soul."

programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Cannonball Adderley, Nat Adderley, Yusuf Lateef & Joe Zawinul
programme.desc: Cannonball Adderley: Live in '63 boasts two beautifully filmed concerts from one of the most celebrated sextets in jazz history, captured at the top of their game. Cannonball Adderley (alto sax), Nat Adderley (cornet), and the masterful Yusef Lateef (tenor sax, flute, oboe), provide a massive three-horn frontline attack, while the stellar rhythm section featuring a pre-Weather Report Joe Zawinul (piano), Sam Jones (bass), and Louis Hayes (drums) fuel the songs with a deep infectious swing. Quincy Jones' "Jessica's Day" leaps from the gate with a huge big band sound that is extraordinary for only six musicians. This recording is a reminder that Cannonball Adderley was one of the most outstanding and highly respected alto saxophonists in the history of jazz. He was a bluesy jazzman who could play anything in superb fashion.

programme.title: Stan Getz
programme.desc: Regarded as the greatest instrumental soloist of all-time, Stanley Gayetzky, famously known as Stan Getz emerged as one of the most significant musical forces in the world of jazz post World War II. With his distinctively warm and lyrical tone, Getz is fondly dubbed as ‘The Sound' because of his singularity and musical innovations. His commitment to music is evident from his long body of work that includes over 300 pieces of musical compositions. Ranked among America's top tenor saxophone players, Getz was a gifted saxophonist who could play just about anything on it, a quality that put him on top of the polls. He is accredited for playing some of the best jazz with some of the best jazzmen in the country. However, his personal life was a rollercoaster ride — tumultuous and loused up by abjection, alcohol, addiction and furious flare-ups. This program shows his last public performance, recorded at Munich Philharmonic Hall, Germany on July 18, 1990. Stan Getz (tenor sax) is accompanied by Kenny Barron (piano), Eddie Del Barrio and Frank Zottoli (synthesizers), Alex Blake (bass) and Terri Lyne Carrington (drums).

programme.title: Chet Baker
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Al McKay & Earth Wind & Fire Experience
programme.sub-title: Al McKay's Earth, Wind & Fire Experience
programme.desc: Every year since 1970, the German city of Burghausen has been hosting one of the largest jazz festivals in the world. During Burghausen International Jazz Week, Burghausen becomes a 'Bavarian jazz mecca': guests from all over the world join the Burghausers to enjoy the most wonderful jazz performances as the colorful hustle and bustle of spectators and musicians shake up the city. One of the bands performing here in 2019 is The Earth, Wind & Fire Experience. In this concert, original Earth, Wind & Fire guitarist, writer and musical director Al McKay performs the band's timeless disco and soul. Together with seven of the thirteen original Earth, Wind & Fire members, he keep hits such as Boogie Wonderland and September alive, touring all over the world.

programme.title: Dizzy Gillespie, Tony Coe, Derek Humble & Billy Mitchell
programme.desc: American jazz trumpeter, composer, and bandleader Dizzy Gillespie (1917-1993) was one of the seminal figures of the bebop movement. He fuses all musical forms rooted in African culture, such as music from Cuba, Latin America and the Caribbean, into his music. On November 4, 1970 he played a concert in Denmark with the Kenny Clarke/Francy Boland Big Band, performing Con Alma, Brother K, Now Hear My Meanin', Manteca, Let Me Outta Here, and Things Are Here.

programme.title: Charles Bradley, William Aukstik, Frederick Deboe & Michael Deller
programme.sub-title: Charles Bradley: The Screaming Eagle Of Soul
programme.desc: This concert of soul singer Charles Bradley (1948-2017) was recorded in an intimate setting in Paris in September 2014. Before considering a career in music, Bradley had long tried to make ends meet with a series of small jobs. It was only in 1996 that he finally followed in the footsteps of his idol and soul icon James Brown, with whom he shared an exceptional ability to bring audiences to ecstasy. Bradley has developed a unique sound that combines funk, soul, and R&B, but still tinged with Brown influences.

programme.title: Quatuor Ebène
programme.desc: Renowned French string quartet Quatuor Ébène marked the 250th birth anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) with a remarkable project: recording all of the great composer's sixteen string quartets. For five years, violinists Pierre Colombet and Gabriel Le Magadure, violist Marie Chilemme, and cellist Raphaël Merlin immersed themselves in Beethoven's 650 pages of sheet music. Their efforts culminated in the performance of the composer's complete repertoire for string quartet, which covers three decades of Beethoven's musical creativity, during six impressive concerts at Philharmonie de Paris in the autumn of 2020. Quatuor Ébène explored every facet of Beethoven's string quartet repertoire: from the youthful Opus 18 string quartets to the Razumovsky, Harp, and Serioso quartets (Opus 59, 74, and 95) from his middle period, and finally, the depth of his late quartets (Opus 127 to 135). This program features Quatuor Ébène performing Beethoven's String Quartet No. 2 in G major, Op. 18, No. 2 String Quartet No. 16 in F major, Op. 135 and String Quartet No. 14 in C-sharp minor, Op. 131. This concert was recorded at Philharmonie de Paris on December 16, 2020.

programme.title: Ragna Schirmer
programme.sub-title: The Three Lives of Clara Schumann
programme.desc: The documentary “The Three Lives of Clara Schumann” traces the fascinating life story of German pianist and composer Clara Schumann. Born Clara Wieck in Leipzig in 1819, she was an exceptionally talented pianist, with an impressive international music career. She first met Robert Schumann, whom she married in 1840 and eventually had eight children with, in 1828. Basing itself on her letters and diaries, her compositions, and on accounts from musicians who have intensively studied her music, this 2019 documentary offers a multi-angled perspective on Clara Schumann. It records the various places where she lived, and the cities she visited as a pianist. This thought-provoking film was directed by Andreas Morell and Magdalena Zieba-Schwind.

programme.title: Fabio Luisi, Danish National Symphony Orchestra & In Mo Yang
programme.sub-title: Luisi conducts Paganini's Violin Concerto & Brahms
programme.desc: Fabio Luisi conducts the Danish National Symphony Orchestra in a performance of two great works. Paganini's Violin Concerto No. 1. is paired with Brahms' dramatic symphonic debut, Symphony No.1. Paganini's concerto dates from the mid-to-late 1810s, written as the composer was touring Italy with his remarkable violin technique. This piece is a quintessential expression of Paganini's extraordinary skill and ability, demanding much from the soloist. It is also characterized by the notably operatic “bel canto” style adopted by many of the composer's contemporaries, including Gioachino Rossini. This exceptional performance features the dazzling virtuosity of violinist In Mo Yang, winner of the 2015 Paganini Competition. It was recorded at the DR Koncerthuset in Copenhagen, Denmark, in 2017.

programme.title: Renaud Capuçon, Gerard Causse, Iddo Bar-Shai & Jean-Jacques Kantorow
programme.sub-title: Chamber music by Mozart and Shostakovich
programme.desc: French violinist Renaud Capuçon appears at the festival Les Coups de Cœur de Chantilly, presenting a chamber music program consisting of classical and 20th century repertoire. He performs with the soloists of the International Menuhin Music Academy led by French conductor Jean-Jacques Kantorow. First on the program is Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart's Sinfonia Concertante in E-flat major, K. 364, in which Capuçon and violist Gérard Caussé appear as the soloists. Capuçon is then joined by pianist Iddo Bar-Shaï for a performance of Mozart's Sonata for violin and piano in E minor, K. 304. The program closes with Dmitri Shostakovich's Chamber Symphony in C minor, Op. 110a, which is a transcription of Shostakovich's String Quartet No. 8 by Russian conductor Rudolf Barshai, the composer's close friend. This performance was recorded at Château de Chantilly, on May 15, 2021.

programme.title: Iván Fischer & Orchestra del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino
programme.sub-title: Mozart Symphony No. 34 & Dvořák Symphony No. 7
programme.desc: Maestro Iván Fischer leads the Orchestra del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in a remarkable concert program of works by Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart and Antonín Dvořák. Mozart's Symphony No. 34 in C major, K. 338 opens the program. Completed in the summer of 1780, this was the last symphony Mozart wrote in Salzburg, where he worked as a court musician. The three-movement symphony features two vibrant outer movements with fanfares and rousing themes, while the quieter second movement is scored for strings alone, deviating from the typical four-movement structure of the time. Next on the program is Dvořák's Symphony No. 7 in D minor, Op. 70, completed in March 1885 and premiered one month later in London conducted by the composer himself. With its dramatic and dark style, this symphony stands in stark contrast to the predominantly optimistic tone of Dvořák's broader oeuvre. This performance was recorded at Teatro del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in Florence, Italy, on January 29, 2021.

programme.title: Seal
programme.desc: Seals one-of-a-kind soaring, husky baritone voice is perfect for any genre. Hes delighted fans and earned critical acclaim while staying true to classic, honest songwriting in his remarkable two-decade career. And now, hes done it again with the release of his exceptional sixth studio album Soul. Together with legendary music producer David Foster, Seal adds his signature touch to some of the best soul songs ever created. In a stunning performance, Seal evokes an era when music vividly captured emotion and romance. Joined by Foster, as well as a choir and string section, Seal takes on Ann Pebbles I Cant Stand the Rain, Sam Cookes A Change Is Gonna Come, and Harold Melvin and the Blue Notes If You Dont Know Me By Now. Tune in and catch more timeless favorites and hits like Kiss From a Rose.

programme.desc: Russell Crowe stars as Noah in the timeless story of courage, sacrifice, and hope. This visually stunning, action-adventure is hailed as "one of the most unforgettable Biblical epics ever put on film." *Richard Roeper, Chicago-Sun-Times

programme.title: Black Knight
programme.desc: When a wisecracking black hustler from South Central L.A. finds himself transported back to medieval England, he leads the overthrow of an evil king and wins the heart of a proto feminist woman.

programme.title: Legendary
programme.desc: Cal Chetley is a bright, engaging, undersized fifteen year-old who's been picked on most of his life. Cal joins his high school wrestling team in the hopes his brother will train him. More importantly, Cal uses wrestling as the tool to reunite his family.

programme.title: The Way Back (2011)
programme.desc: A small band of convicts stage a daring escape from a World War II-era Siberian gulag, and embark on a treacherous journey across five countries in a race for freedom and survival.

programme.title: Leprechaun
programme.desc: A horrific Leprechaun goes on a rampage after his precious bag of gold coins is stolen. He uses all of his magical destructive powers to trick, terrorize, and kill anyone who is unlucky enough to hinder his relentless search.

programme.title: Leprechaun 3
programme.desc: The Leprechaun is trying his luck in Las Vegas after a college student stumbles upon stolen gold shillings.

programme.title: Leprechaun 4: In Space
programme.desc: The evil leprechaun returns with a new plot to become king of an alien planet.

programme.title: Leprechaun V: In the Hood
programme.desc: A group of rappers steal a magical flute that instantly makes them successful but also awakens the leprechaun.

programme.title: I Kill Giants
programme.desc: Barbara Thorson (Madison Wolfe) is a teenage girl who escapes the realities of school and a troubled family life by retreating into her magical world of fighting evil giants. With the help of her new friend Sophia (Sydney Wade) and her school counsellor (Zoe Saldana), Barbara learns to face her fears and battle the giants that threaten her world.

programme.title: Push
programme.desc: Riveting Sci-Fi action-thriller Push is set in a deadly world of psychic espionage where the ability to move objects using only the mind, see the future, create new realities and kill without ever touching the victim can turn a person into a lethal weapon - or a target. A young man (Chris Evans - Sunshine, Fantastic Four ) and a teenage girl with extraordinary gifts (Dakota Fanning - War of the Worlds) take on a clandestine agency in a battle they can win only if they change the future.

programme.title: Love N' Dancing
programme.desc: Jessica (Amy Smart) had given up on her dream of a life of the stage, until she meets ex-dance champion Jake (Tom Malloy), who becomes her teacher when the couple make an instant connection. Together, they decide to risk it all when they enter the World Swing Championship to reclaim Jake's former title.

programme.title: Queen of the Desert
programme.desc: A chronicle of Gertrude Bell's life, a traveler, writer, archaeologist, explorer, cartographer, and political attach for the British Empire at the dawn of the twentieth century.

programme.title: Walking Out
programme.desc: Gripping, exhilarating and a whole-heartedly rich emotional rollercoaster. Fourteen-year-old urban teenager David journeys to the remote mountains of Montana to hunt big game with his estranged father. They struggle to see eye to eye and develop a bond, until a brutal encounter in the heart of the wilderness changes everything for father and son forcing them to strive to survive together.

programme.title: David & Goliath
programme.desc: Expect bloodshed, epic action sequences and sheer fearlessness, in the greatest story ever told! At the crossroads of two great ancient empires, a innocent shepherd named David transforms into a powerful warrior and takes on a terrifyingly violent giant named Goliath. One of history's most legendary Biblical battles is retold in a stylistic, bloody tale of courage and faith.

programme.title: Slightly Single in LA
programme.desc: Fun, flirty and downright outrageous. Independent, LA singleton Dale (Lacey Chabert, Mean Girls) is sick and tired of her troublesome love life. On the verge of giving up, she is reunited with an old friend - successful heartthrob and rock star Zach. Is this Dale's lucky chance to fall in love? Also starring Jenna Dewan (Step Up) and Jonathan Bennett (Mean Girls). Perfect for a girls night in!

programme.title: Bulletproof
programme.desc: A gritty and riveting crime thriller following two LAPD officers as they hunt two cop killers on the loose in a city about to boil over. Training Day meets End of Watch, this is a brutal look at the extreme danger and unthinkable sacrifices police officers face when they commit to serve and protect the public. Starring Thomas Jane (The Mist) and Luke Kleintank (The Man in the High Castle).

programme.title: Where hands touch
programme.desc: In 1944, a 15-year-old girl, daughter of a white German mother and a black African father, meets a member of the Hitler Youth. They become bound by the realization of the horrors being committed around them.

programme.title: Life of a King
programme.desc: Ex-felon, Eugene Brown, establishes a Chess Club for inner city teenagers in Washington, D.C.

programme.title: Rex
programme.desc: Rex is based on the true-life story of young Marine Corporal Megan Leavey whose unique discipline and bond with her military combat dog saved many lives during their deployment in Iraq.

programme.title: Twinkle All The Way
programme.desc: (2019) Festive romance with Sarah Drew. Two single parents find themselves growing closer as they juggle a wedding and a VIP Christmas Eve party, discovering love in unexpected places.

programme.title: Charming Christmas
programme.desc: (2015) Holiday romance with Julie Benz. An uptight woman agrees to play Mrs Claus at her family's department store, and finds herself becoming merrier working alongside a charming man playing Santa.

programme.title: A Date By Christmas
programme.desc: (2019) Christmas romance with Vanessa Lengies. When the dating app she created grants her magical powers, can Chelsea use her abilities to help the 'naughty' people in her life onto the nice list?

programme.title: Christmas Unwrapped
programme.desc: A reporter investigates a man who insists that all of the Christmas gifts his charity gives are magically supplied by Santa Claus. Starring Amber Stevens West (2020)

programme.title: Cross Country Christmas
programme.desc: (2020) Romcom with Rachael Leigh Cook and Greyston Holt. When a snowstorm grounds planes and halts trains, can two old friends make it ho-ho-home for Christmas - no matter the mode of transport?

programme.title: The Wedding Fix
programme.desc: Reeling from a break-up, professional over-planner Gwen pitches in to help put the finishing touches on her best friend's wedding. But when she's teamed up with best man Josh, a free-spirited nature guide, she finds that pulling together this wedding might not be as easy as she thought.

programme.title: A Little Something For Your Birthday
programme.desc: Senna, a struggling designer who hasn't quite found herself has given up on finding her soulmate. Despite attempts, by her best friend, to get her to settle down and pursue her passion of fashion, Senna continues down a path of irresponsible behaviour, lost jobs, and casual hook-ups with younger men

programme.title: Meet Me in New York
programme.desc: Kelly is a young, creative, ambitious events planner in New York City and quickly gaining a reputation as one of the best in the business. But when Joe, an influential website editor, hires her to organize his niece's 10th birthday party, Kelly quickly realizes that she may have just met her match.

programme.title: Listen Out for Love
programme.desc: Peyton Pepper, a goal-driven podcast producer, is forced to mold Alex McKinney, a brash loose cannon, into her next star and create the perfect show to save both of their careers. That show comes in the form of finding Peyton's iconic idol, true love.

programme.title: A Christmas Princess
programme.desc: A prince from Europe comes to New York for a royal holiday dinner and falls in love with the chef that is planning the event.

programme.title: Autumn Stables
programme.desc: After her husband's death, Autumn sells her ranch to Jake expecting nothing will change, but Jake has ulterior motives with the land and her heart. Starring: Cindy Busby, Kevin McGarry, Alys Crocker

programme.title: You Can't Fight Christmas
programme.desc: Interior designer Leslie Major loves all things Christmas. When she meets handsome Edmund James, she quickly learns he thinks the festivities are frivolous and superficial.

programme.title: Christmas in Wonderland
programme.desc: Starring Patrick Swayze and Chris Kattan. Three children and their father move from California to Canada. When they go shopping at the mall, they find counterfeit cash, inadvertently help catch crooks, and make a discovery about Santa.

programme.title: Christmas on Mistletoe Lake
programme.desc: Reilly finds herself in the magical town of Mistletoe Lake. She accepts the offer of Ray to stay in his boat, helping him renovate for the town's Christmas Harbor Festival. Reilly embarks on a journey to save the towns she fell in love with.

programme.title: Timeless Love
programme.desc: Megan seems to have the perfect life with a wonderful husband named Thomas and 2 adorable children. Then she finds herself awakening from a coma – and discovers she is not and has never been married. But when she meets Thomas for real, she seizes the chance to help him fall in love with her, again—for the first time.

programme.title: Made For You with Love
programme.desc: The owner of used wedding gown business breathes new life into used dresses, making dreams come true for brides unable to afford pricey gowns. But when she meets the perfect guy, she's afraid to give her own heart a second chance at love.

programme.title: Scents and Sensibility
programme.desc: In this modern adaptation of Jane Austen's Sense and Sensibility, Elinor and Marianne find themselves penniless after their father's fortune is taken away. As they look for ways to pay the bills, they encounter people who judge them and try to keep them down in the dumps. Add falling in love into the mix, and determining whom to trust becomes a mine field. Can the sisters find a balance between relying on their hearts and using good sense without losing everything they hold dear?

programme.title: Mary 4 Mayor
programme.desc: Running for mayor against her incumbent mayor father, an eighteen-year-old young woman learns valuable life lessons that not only are the building blocks to saving her family, but also the town she lives in.

programme.title: The Baby Proposal
programme.desc: Layla Bennett and Derek Dray are the hosts of Wake Up, Chicago and for the folks at home, their chemistry is undeniable. Derek is incredibly protective about the format of Wakeup, Chicago while Layla is always looking to shake things up. One morning they discover an adorable baby named Poppy left in a basket in Laylas dressing room. The mother passed away and the caretaker is unable to care for Poppy and is convinced that Layla and Derek will make perfect parents.

programme.title: Stranger In My Bed
programme.desc: Sarah leaves her abusive husband by faking her own death.

programme.title: Stranger at the Door
programme.desc: Adopted son returns with bad intentions parents unsure how to react.

programme.title: If Walls Could Talk
programme.desc: Olivia moves home to help her mother and strange things keep happening.

programme.title: Surviving Abduction
programme.desc: Five women share their harrowing accounts of abduction and imprisonment.

programme.title: Stranger In My Bed
programme.desc: Sarah leaves her abusive husband by faking her own death.

programme.title: Love at Sunset Terrace
programme.desc: A girl tries to play matchmaker for her widowed father when a woman rents one of his rooms.

programme.title: The Wrong Husband
programme.desc: Melanie discovers her husband is actually his twin, Alex, back to steal his life—and willing to kill for it.

programme.title: Love You to Death
programme.desc: A prosecutor must work on a case which reminds her of her childhood, when her mother was killed by her alcoholic father.

programme.title: Killer in Suburbia
programme.desc: Gina and her daughter move to a new town, but when she is abducted, Gina must save her and trust no one.

programme.title: Punchline
programme.desc: Stand-up comedy hopefuls toil in obscurity at a New York club while waiting for their big break.

programme.title: Think Like A Man
programme.desc: Four friends conspire to turn the tables on their women when they discover the ladies have been using Steve Harvey's relationship advice against them.

programme.title: Mona Lisa Smile
programme.desc: Julia Roberts stars as a novice art history professor with a surprising lesson plan that inspires her students to open their eyes to love and life.

programme.title: Almost Famous
programme.desc: Rolling Stone Magazine unwittingly hires a 15 year old aspiring journalist after reading an article he wrote for Cream Magazine. ALMOST FAMOUS is the hilarious and touching story of this intelligent young man's journey into the world of Rock-and-Roll as he tours with "Stillwater", an up-and-coming band struggling with their rise to fame.

programme.title: Super Fuzz
programme.desc: Stricken by radiation, an agent acquires superpowers with which he breaks up a gang of counterfeiters who print bills on a fishing boat that he disposes of along with frozen fish. Among the superpowers are bullets stopped with his teeth.

programme.title: Dear Elizabeth
programme.desc: A man who leads a dull life accidentally stalks an old college classmate, actress Elizabeth Banks, on social media. He rediscovers more of himself and the true meaning of friendship in his attempts to prove he knows her.

programme.title: The Pink Panther 2
programme.desc: When legendary treasures from around the world are stolen, including the priceless Pink Panther diamond, Clouseau is assigned to a dream team of international detectives who are under pressure to bring the master thief to justice before he strikes again.

programme.title: Bogus
programme.desc: When a young boy's mother dies, he invents an imaginary friend to accompany him to his new home far away. How can a boy be lonely with a gentle giant named Bogus? Gerard Depardieu and Whoopi Goldberg star together for the first time in this warmhearted tale of magic and fantasy.

programme.title: Long Days of Vengeance
programme.desc: After three years of brutal labor for a crime he didn't commit, ex-Sheriff Ted Barnett escapes prison to hunt down the three men who framed him for his father's murder. "Long Days of Vengeance" is a gripping spaghetti western about justice, revenge, and redemption under the scorching desert sun.

programme.title: The Star Packer
programme.desc: A gang working for The Shadow is terrorizing the town. John Travers decides to take on the job of sheriff and do something about it.

programme.title: Alien Thunder
programme.desc: Based on an actual event, this is the tragic story of Saskatchewan fugitive Almighty Voice (Gordon Tootoosis), a Cree Indian who is arrested for stealing government livestock out of desperate hunger.

programme.title: Watch Out Gringo! Sabata Will Return
programme.desc: A gang of bandits, led by the infamous Luke Morgan, hijacks a stagecoach carrying an army gold strongbox and takes a hostage. But when Carrancho steals the gold from them, hiding it in a grave, the chase intensifies. Both sides race to recover the treasure, with lives at stake and a relentless pursuit in the wild.

programme.title: Angel and the Badman
programme.desc: Old Western Movie starring John Wayne: Angel and the Badman - Quirt Evans, an all round bad guy, is nursed back to health and sought after by Penelope Worth, a Quaker girl. He eventually finds himself having to choose between his world and the world Penelope lives in.

programme.title: The Hideout
programme.desc: An insurance investigator has a chance encounter with the sister of a fur dealer.

programme.title: Blackmail
programme.desc: Alice White, sweetheart of detective Frank Webber, murders an artist who attempts to seduce her in his studio

programme.title: House in Nightmare Park
programme.desc: Foster Twelvetrees can't believe his luck when he's offered a fee to give a reading at a stately mansion.

programme.title: Act of Murder
programme.desc: An actor attempts to win back his former mistress by putting stress on her husband.

programme.title: The Arsenal Stadium Mystery
programme.desc: A footballer collapses during a match and Scotland Yard investigates when poison is discovered.

programme.title: French Connection
programme.desc: While on a lecture tour with Nigel in Europe, Sydney is contacted by MI5 because she is the only one who can prevent an impending high-level assassination.

programme.title: Midnight Flight
programme.desc: Germania, ca. 400 AD: an artifact called Gunther's Scepter is sealed in a vault. Kleine Burgh, 2001: Sydney and Nigel are hired to find it using a crystal and a stone tablet.

programme.title: The Executioners Mask
programme.desc: When a model's face is disfigured after she puts on the mask of a French executioner, Sydney and Nigel will try and find the tomb to reverse the curse.

programme.title: The Royal Ring
programme.desc: When the British Museum gets Sidney and Nigel to help search at Tudor sites for a ring of King Henry VIII, Nigel is confronted with his self-confident pestering elder brother Preston Bailey.

programme.title: Set in Stone
programme.desc: In a monastery, Knight Gabriel impales a demon, which then turns to stone. In 2001, Nigel and Sydney arrive bearing a letter from a monk, but the abbot claims it is a forgery and shuts them out.

programme.title: Deadline
programme.desc: Allan comes to Sydney, telling he has 12 hours before a Necron virus kills him unless he delivers Tau to a blackmailer who has the antidote.

programme.title: Wages of Sydney
programme.desc: Quan Shu, Manchuria 1359 BC: The Chinese invent an explosive gift egg. New York, 2001: A rival beats Sydney and Nigel to a map leading to the Dragon's Egg.

programme.title: Vampires Kiss
programme.desc: Lucas Blackmer, a babe-magnet, professor and a novelist asks Sydney to help find Vlad Tepes' lost relic. And he isn't the only one after it.

programme.title: Iron Fury
programme.desc: In 1944, a young lieutenant leads a courageous group of Russian soldiers in a German POW camp, plotting a daring escape from captivity in a half-dest

programme.title: Tracers
programme.desc: It's a race for survival in the criminal underworld of New York in the action-packed thriller TRACERS.

programme.title: Behind The Line
programme.desc: Occupied France, 1940. A Nazi Commander discovers one of his prisoners, Danny (Sam Gittins) is a champion boxer. He forces him to fight for his companies entertainment.

programme.title: Adrift
programme.desc: Adrift is based on the inspiring true story of two sailors who set out to journey across the ocean from Tahiti to San Diego...

programme.title: Lost Treasure of Jesse James
programme.desc: When their family homes are threatened by a local land developer, a group of youngsters set out to locate the mysterious James brothers' treasure, a legend that may just save Ford county and allow them to keep their family homes forever.

programme.title: Miss Bala (2019)
programme.desc: A beauty contest winner is forced to work for a crime boss after she witnesses a murder. Remake of the 2011 film.

programme.title: Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon
programme.desc: A legendary warrior's stolen magic sword becomes the centerpiece of epic, intertwining love stories, set against the breathtaking landscapes of ancient China.

programme.title: The Blue Lagoon (1980)
programme.desc: Brooke Shields and Christopher Atkins star as shipwrecked teenagers learning the mysteries of love in a South Pacific paradise.

programme.title: Wind Chill
programme.desc: Two college students share a ride home for the holidays. When they break down on a deserted stretch of road, they're preyed upon by the ghosts of people who have died there.

programme.title: Dead Awake
programme.desc: Kate Bowman is a by-the-books social worker who is investigating a series of mysterious deaths. Each victim suffered from sleep paralysis, a frightening ailment that immobilizes its victims as they dream. Kate is approached by an unorthodox doctor who warns of an evil entity that haunts people in their sleep. She brushes aside his admonition, but when a terrifying entity begins to haunt Kate's friends and loved ones, she must fight to stay awake to stop the nightmare she's unleashed.

programme.title: Homeboy [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Though only in his 20s, professional boxer Johnny Walker is on the downswing of his career and suffering from a mild form of brain damage. Resettling in the beachfront resort of Asbury Park, N.J., he falls in with shady promoter Wesley Pendergass and meets kindhearted boardwalk operator Ruby. When Wesley proposes cutting Johnny in on a criminal undertaking, Johnny must choose between a life of crime and a settled future with Ruby.

programme.title: The Crush [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Writer Nick Eliot moves to a new city for a magazine job and rents a room in the house of Cliff and Liv Forrester, whose 14-year-old daughter, Adrian, instantly makes her attraction to Nick clear. While Nick romances photographer Amy Maddik at work, he has trouble fending off Adrian's advances. As her obsession with Nick grows, Adrian becomes angry at being rejected and starts attacking his property and friends.

programme.title: House (1985) [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: A mounted fish moves, household objects levitate, and monsters haunt a troubled novelist (William Katt).

programme.title: Freeway [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: A crazed driver with a deeply troubled past goes on a nightly shooting spree across the highways of America.

programme.title: JCVD [English-Language Version] [Broadcast Edit]

programme.title: Woody Herman, Paul Fontaine, Billy Hunt & Bill Chase
programme.sub-title: Woody Herman's Swinging Herd live in England 1964
programme.desc: Woody Herman: Live in '64 features a blistering one-hour concert from 1964 showcasing one of the very hottest line-ups of the "Swinging Herd," including trumpeter Bill Chase, trombonist Phil Wilson, and the amazing saxophonist Sal Nistico on the front line, as well as drummer Jake Hanna, bassist Chuck Andrus, and pianist-arranger Nat Pierce in the rhythm section. The band roars throughout the entire show which includes standards such as "Lonesome Old Town", "After You've Gone", and new originals including Charles Mingus's "Better Git It In Your Soul."

programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Cannonball Adderley, Nat Adderley, Yusuf Lateef & Joe Zawinul
programme.desc: Cannonball Adderley: Live in '63 boasts two beautifully filmed concerts from one of the most celebrated sextets in jazz history, captured at the top of their game. Cannonball Adderley (alto sax), Nat Adderley (cornet), and the masterful Yusef Lateef (tenor sax, flute, oboe), provide a massive three-horn frontline attack, while the stellar rhythm section featuring a pre-Weather Report Joe Zawinul (piano), Sam Jones (bass), and Louis Hayes (drums) fuel the songs with a deep infectious swing. Quincy Jones' "Jessica's Day" leaps from the gate with a huge big band sound that is extraordinary for only six musicians. This recording is a reminder that Cannonball Adderley was one of the most outstanding and highly respected alto saxophonists in the history of jazz. He was a bluesy jazzman who could play anything in superb fashion.

programme.title: Rahsaan Roland Kirk
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Stan Getz
programme.desc: Regarded as the greatest instrumental soloist of all-time, Stanley Gayetzky, famously known as Stan Getz emerged as one of the most significant musical forces in the world of jazz post World War II. With his distinctively warm and lyrical tone, Getz is fondly dubbed as ‘The Sound' because of his singularity and musical innovations. His commitment to music is evident from his long body of work that includes over 300 pieces of musical compositions. Ranked among America's top tenor saxophone players, Getz was a gifted saxophonist who could play just about anything on it, a quality that put him on top of the polls. He is accredited for playing some of the best jazz with some of the best jazzmen in the country. However, his personal life was a rollercoaster ride — tumultuous and loused up by abjection, alcohol, addiction and furious flare-ups. This program shows his last public performance, recorded at Munich Philharmonic Hall, Germany on July 18, 1990. Stan Getz (tenor sax) is accompanied by Kenny Barron (piano), Eddie Del Barrio and Frank Zottoli (synthesizers), Alex Blake (bass) and Terri Lyne Carrington (drums).

programme.title: Chet Baker
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Al McKay & Earth Wind & Fire Experience
programme.sub-title: Al McKay's Earth, Wind & Fire Experience
programme.desc: Every year since 1970, the German city of Burghausen has been hosting one of the largest jazz festivals in the world. During Burghausen International Jazz Week, Burghausen becomes a 'Bavarian jazz mecca': guests from all over the world join the Burghausers to enjoy the most wonderful jazz performances as the colorful hustle and bustle of spectators and musicians shake up the city. One of the bands performing here in 2019 is The Earth, Wind & Fire Experience. In this concert, original Earth, Wind & Fire guitarist, writer and musical director Al McKay performs the band's timeless disco and soul. Together with seven of the thirteen original Earth, Wind & Fire members, he keep hits such as Boogie Wonderland and September alive, touring all over the world.

programme.title: Dizzy Gillespie, Tony Coe, Derek Humble & Billy Mitchell
programme.desc: American jazz trumpeter, composer, and bandleader Dizzy Gillespie (1917-1993) was one of the seminal figures of the bebop movement. He fuses all musical forms rooted in African culture, such as music from Cuba, Latin America and the Caribbean, into his music. On November 4, 1970 he played a concert in Denmark with the Kenny Clarke/Francy Boland Big Band, performing Con Alma, Brother K, Now Hear My Meanin', Manteca, Let Me Outta Here, and Things Are Here.

programme.title: Quatuor Ebène
programme.desc: Renowned French string quartet Quatuor Ébène marked the 250th birth anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) with a remarkable project: recording all of the great composer's sixteen string quartets. For five years, violinists Pierre Colombet and Gabriel Le Magadure, violist Marie Chilemme, and cellist Raphaël Merlin immersed themselves in Beethoven's 650 pages of sheet music. Their efforts culminated in the performance of the composer's complete repertoire for string quartet, which covers three decades of Beethoven's musical creativity, during six impressive concerts at Philharmonie de Paris in the autumn of 2020. Quatuor Ébène explored every facet of Beethoven's string quartet repertoire: from the youthful Opus 18 string quartets to the Razumovsky, Harp, and Serioso quartets (Opus 59, 74, and 95) from his middle period, and finally, the depth of his late quartets (Opus 127 to 135). This program features Quatuor Ébène performing Beethoven's String Quartet No. 2 in G major, Op. 18, No. 2 String Quartet No. 16 in F major, Op. 135 and String Quartet No. 14 in C-sharp minor, Op. 131. This concert was recorded at Philharmonie de Paris on December 16, 2020.

programme.title: Ragna Schirmer
programme.sub-title: The Three Lives of Clara Schumann
programme.desc: The documentary “The Three Lives of Clara Schumann” traces the fascinating life story of German pianist and composer Clara Schumann. Born Clara Wieck in Leipzig in 1819, she was an exceptionally talented pianist, with an impressive international music career. She first met Robert Schumann, whom she married in 1840 and eventually had eight children with, in 1828. Basing itself on her letters and diaries, her compositions, and on accounts from musicians who have intensively studied her music, this 2019 documentary offers a multi-angled perspective on Clara Schumann. It records the various places where she lived, and the cities she visited as a pianist. This thought-provoking film was directed by Andreas Morell and Magdalena Zieba-Schwind.

programme.title: Fabio Luisi, Danish National Symphony Orchestra & In Mo Yang
programme.sub-title: Luisi conducts Paganini's Violin Concerto & Brahms
programme.desc: Fabio Luisi conducts the Danish National Symphony Orchestra in a performance of two great works. Paganini's Violin Concerto No. 1. is paired with Brahms' dramatic symphonic debut, Symphony No.1. Paganini's concerto dates from the mid-to-late 1810s, written as the composer was touring Italy with his remarkable violin technique. This piece is a quintessential expression of Paganini's extraordinary skill and ability, demanding much from the soloist. It is also characterized by the notably operatic “bel canto” style adopted by many of the composer's contemporaries, including Gioachino Rossini. This exceptional performance features the dazzling virtuosity of violinist In Mo Yang, winner of the 2015 Paganini Competition. It was recorded at the DR Koncerthuset in Copenhagen, Denmark, in 2017.

programme.title: Renaud Capuçon, Gerard Causse, Iddo Bar-Shai & Jean-Jacques Kantorow
programme.sub-title: Chamber music by Mozart and Shostakovich
programme.desc: French violinist Renaud Capuçon appears at the festival Les Coups de Cœur de Chantilly, presenting a chamber music program consisting of classical and 20th century repertoire. He performs with the soloists of the International Menuhin Music Academy led by French conductor Jean-Jacques Kantorow. First on the program is Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart's Sinfonia Concertante in E-flat major, K. 364, in which Capuçon and violist Gérard Caussé appear as the soloists. Capuçon is then joined by pianist Iddo Bar-Shaï for a performance of Mozart's Sonata for violin and piano in E minor, K. 304. The program closes with Dmitri Shostakovich's Chamber Symphony in C minor, Op. 110a, which is a transcription of Shostakovich's String Quartet No. 8 by Russian conductor Rudolf Barshai, the composer's close friend. This performance was recorded at Château de Chantilly, on May 15, 2021.

programme.title: Iván Fischer & Orchestra del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino
programme.sub-title: Mozart Symphony No. 34 & Dvořák Symphony No. 7
programme.desc: Maestro Iván Fischer leads the Orchestra del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in a remarkable concert program of works by Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart and Antonín Dvořák. Mozart's Symphony No. 34 in C major, K. 338 opens the program. Completed in the summer of 1780, this was the last symphony Mozart wrote in Salzburg, where he worked as a court musician. The three-movement symphony features two vibrant outer movements with fanfares and rousing themes, while the quieter second movement is scored for strings alone, deviating from the typical four-movement structure of the time. Next on the program is Dvořák's Symphony No. 7 in D minor, Op. 70, completed in March 1885 and premiered one month later in London conducted by the composer himself. With its dramatic and dark style, this symphony stands in stark contrast to the predominantly optimistic tone of Dvořák's broader oeuvre. This performance was recorded at Teatro del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in Florence, Italy, on January 29, 2021.

programme.title: Seal
programme.desc: Seals one-of-a-kind soaring, husky baritone voice is perfect for any genre. Hes delighted fans and earned critical acclaim while staying true to classic, honest songwriting in his remarkable two-decade career. And now, hes done it again with the release of his exceptional sixth studio album Soul. Together with legendary music producer David Foster, Seal adds his signature touch to some of the best soul songs ever created. In a stunning performance, Seal evokes an era when music vividly captured emotion and romance. Joined by Foster, as well as a choir and string section, Seal takes on Ann Pebbles I Cant Stand the Rain, Sam Cookes A Change Is Gonna Come, and Harold Melvin and the Blue Notes If You Dont Know Me By Now. Tune in and catch more timeless favorites and hits like Kiss From a Rose.

programme.title: The Doobie Brothers
programme.desc: Filmed in high definition on 25 July 2004 at Wolf Trap National Park for the Performing Arts in Virginia, "Live At Wolf Trap" captures The Doobie Brothers in fine form on a set that mixes classic hits with some rarely performed tracks from across their extensive catalogue. This would prove to be the last recorded footage of long time drummer Keith Knudsen performing with the Doobie Brothers prior to his sad death from cancer in February 2005.
